description: Finds the routes of the TTC by number or by name. Kinds: bus, minibus, metro, cable_car. With no query, lists every route.

kind.description: Only routes of this kind: bus, minibus, metro, or cable_car.

language.description: The language of the names: ka or en. The default is en.

limit.description: The maximum count of routes, 1 to 100. The default is 20.

query.description: A route number or a part of a route name. Empty gives every route.

name: transit_search_routes

as_of.description: The instant at which the server read the routes, RFC 3339.

routes.description: The matching routes, best match first.

name.description: The name of the route, usually its two ends.

number.description: The route number that the vehicle shows.

source.description: The source of the data: TTC.

stale.description: True when the TTC did not answer and the server returns routes it read before.

title: Search the routes of Tbilisi
